_comment: Fabricated toy schemas for unit tests. Contains NO research data, NO predictions from any model and NO paper results.

schemas.question: A small library keeps authors and the books they wrote.
schemas.description_good: The library database stores every author with an author_id and a full_name. Each book has a book_id and a title and points to its author through author_id.
schemas.description_bad: It is a database about things.

schemas.question: Orders consist of numbered lines, and shipment items refer to one order line.
schemas.description_good: An order_line is identified by order_id together with line_no and carries a sku. A shipment_item has a shipment_id and refers to exactly one order_line through order_id and line_no.

schemas.question: A clinic records patients and their visits.
schemas.description_good: The clinic stores each patient with a patient_id and birth_year, and each visit with a visit_id, a patient_id and a visit_date.

logical_only.question: A logical annotation without genuine DDL.
